column1: # Scope: NO-arg methods only (overloaded setters a/b/c/d/e/f/g/j are deferred -
# they require a descriptor-aware / type-aware rename, unsafe via plain text).
# Receiver-safe: only Unit./this./unit. call sites + declarations are touched,
# so same-named methods on other obfuscated classes are NOT affected.
# Some names are INFERRED from local field usage + UnitType semantics; marked (inf).
# Left obfuscated on purpose (uncertain / interface stubs / duplicate getters):
#   a() b()   -> Sortable overrides returning false (meaning unclear)
#   g()       -> b.k() (UnitType.k() meaning unclear; also collides w/ g(Unit))
#   r() s() t()-> subtle combat-relationship checks (uncertain)
#   v D E F H L T -> ambiguous single-purpose getters
#   Y Z aa ad ae af ag ah ai aj ak -> duplicate getters of an already-named field
